source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.18 with Figs. 9.31 and 9.32 (PDF 220-221).

blocks.text: Potentiometer zyada tar potential differences compare (muqabla) karne aur unknown (na-maloom) resistance ki qeemat nikalne ke liye istemal hota hai. Yeh is principle (usool) par kaam karta hai ke steady current ho to uniform (ek jaisa) taar par potential ka girna taar ki length (lambai) ke proportional hota hai (V ∝ l). Wheatstone bridge ki tarah yeh bhi null (balance) tareeqe se istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke potentiometer "Wheatstone Bridge ke principle" par kaam karta hai. Sahi principle yeh hai ke steady current mein uniform taar par potential ka girna length ke proportional hai, jaisa agle paragraphs khud samjhate hain. Bridge ke saath sirf null tareeqa common hai, principle nahi.
